name: com.azerion.sdk.ads.core.ui.AzerionAdsActivity
description: The Azerion Ads SDK opens this Activity for full-screen interstitial or rewarded video ads. It displays image, HTML, or video creatives and grants the configured reward when a rewarded video is completed.
disableEffect: Interstitial and rewarded ads served here will not display, and watching a rewarded ad will no longer grant its reward.
